priorityList: Ensure Shadowform is active at all times.
Cast Voidform when Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain (or Shadow Word: Madness) are active on the target.
Use Power Infusion, offensive trinkets, and potions during Voidform or when Power Infusion is available.
Cast Void Blast on cooldown during Voidform.
Cast Shadow Word: Madness if it is about to expire, if you have a Mind Devourer proc, or if you have a large Insanity deficit.
Cast Void Torrent when your primary DoTs are active.
Cast Tentacle Slam to refresh Vampiric Touch or if you are about to reach maximum charges.
Cast Shadow Word: Death if the target is below 20% health or if a Deathspeaker proc is active.
Cast Mind Blast whenever available, prioritizing it if you do not have a Mind Devourer proc.
Cast Mind Flay: Insanity whenever available.
Manually refresh Vampiric Touch if it is expiring and Tentacle Slam is not available.
Cast Shadow Word: Death while Mindbender or Shadowfiend is active if Inescapable Torment is talented.
Use Shadow Word: Death as a movement or high-priority filler.
Channel Mind Flay as your primary filler.
